question: Provisions related to the Municipalities are mentioned under which part of the Indian constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Part IX A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Part IX-A of the Indian constitution deals with municipalities.

 
 
• It was added by the 74th amendment act of the Indian constitution.
 
• The 74th amendment act was introduced in 1992.
 
• It came into force on 1st June 1993.
 
• Part IX-A of the Indian constitution covers Article 243 P to 243 ZG.
 
• The act added a new twelfth schedule to the Indian constitution.
 
• The first municipal corporation in India was set up in Madras in 1688.
 
• The Municipal Corporation of Bombay and Calcutta was set up in 1726.
